Weekly scrum for the week of **YYYY-MM-DD**.

**Every team member:** add a comment below (not an edit to this post) by copying this template.
Keep it to 1–2 sentences per item and link the related issues/PRs with `#number`.

```markdown
**What I did this week:**
- ... (#12, #15)

**What I will do next week:**
- ... (#18)

**What is holding me back:**
- Nothing / ...
```
